name: Landmark de bus central del Castillo de la Red

physicalAnchors.assemblyRole: central distribution bus and branching service landmark

mustPreserve: central bus/distribution spine silhouette from the primary reference
branching galleries remain physically connected to the central distribution path
isolators, protections and seals/lockouts remain anchored to real service branches
service indicators stay attached to the branch they describe
maintenance balcony/panel relationship to the distribution landmark
one source feeding several services remains legible at world scale
branch isolation remains physically readable without detaching the puzzle from the world model
pale masonry, orderly copper busbars, ceramic standoff insulators and dark technical switchgear hierarchy
mayResolve: hidden rear fasteners, busbar supports and cable routing not defined by the references
maintenance-side construction that preserves the visible silhouette and branch topology
exact branch spacing and panel detail where the accepted greybox and electrical model leave room
runtime mesh segmentation, material slots and pivot hierarchy
exact dimensions after measurement against the accepted greybox runtime
forbidden: glowing schematic wall or detached puzzle board
ornamental cables with no electrical or mechanical function
passive neon, emissive copper or decorative glow as network state
invented symbols, lore or electrical behavior
redesign of validated topology, branch consequences or protection behavior
free text-to-3D redesign that departs from the primary distribution reference
Meshy or Tripo use without the required HUMAN_GATE
approvalNote: Approved for the adapt reference-pack gate only. This pack records repo-native visual anchors and does not auto-approve the final hero design, modeling, provider use or canonical GLB; final modeling remains blocked until Sol verifies the reference comparison and runtime constraints.

referenceAudit.primaryRationale: prop_castle_master_distributor.png is the repo-native reference that most directly defines the central distribution landmark silhouette; the remaining references provide the monumental room context and trunk/branch routing cues.
